visualFindings.description: The sticky appearance footer overlays input fields as they enter the viewport. At 1100x720 B3 hides the entire Close label input at initial scroll. At 560x640 A3 and C3 hide the entire Title input during scroll, and B3 hides the Close label input.
The Create a dialog button and its insertion-point helper text overlap vertically by 9 CSS pixels at both sizes.

interactionFinding.description: In the existing panel state C3 provides no New screen control. The public-new-screen case failed at both sizes, so the Panel default cannot be reached from an existing screen in this layout.

scopeNotes: All checks used offline Playwright contexts against a file URL. Browser memory simulation only.
The full design:check was not rerun. Earlier run failed in Studio waitState after 448 renders; cause unresolved.
The partial first run used a faulty async lookup in the test script and is retained as report-incomplete.json; it is excluded from these results.
Source commit records HEAD at the start of the completed run.
The created-panel-defaults cases ran as a separate focused six-case follow-up against the same local HTML.
